notes.title: [v1.4.0]
notes.content:
[p]With version 1.4.0 comes the new 11th Dungeon, adding new enemies, items, and a new boss. Complete the 10th Dungeon and finish the related quest to unlock it.

There are also some new features that should improve player experience, such as:[/p][p][/p][h2]Runes[/h2][p]Runes can be acquired by completing a boss' Bestiary entry. Each rune will grant you a passive effect that can change the way you play a bit, ranging from a chance to inflict a status effect to changes that favors specific playstyles. 

You can also upgrade them up to level 20, but they increase in cost each time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45564997/b33dc54acd1d45b104c9a6ce7d992b00b1c370b5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Quality of Life Features[/h2][p]Some of the other changes include quality of life features, like the option to toggle [b]Auto Attack[/b]. This option can be easily toggled from both the Dungeon and Combat interfaces, and should improve the player experience for some of those grindier sections. Be sure to check it out![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45564997/0b97404bee2c3c464d1d944d3fed6c0936099365.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There's also now the option to [b]toggle the combat stats display during battle[/b], along with a new indicator of the enemy's [b]Bestiary progress[/b], and [b]Soul Gems can now be locked[/b] through the Gem Storage, so you don't accidentally meld your favorites.[/p][p][/p][p]Some spells and consumables also got adjusted so they don't spend your entire action bar. These usually apply to buffs, debuffs and support spells.
[/p][p]Other than that, a lot of items got their stats and functionality adjusted and some pesky bugs have been squashed. 

[i]* Note that if you had any items that were buffed or nerfed equipped, some of your character stats might end up getting messed up. Reallocating your stats should fix that![/i][/p][p]
I hope you all like this update, I've been working hard to improve the game according to player feedback. Thank you all for your support, and I see you in the next update! Now, here's the full list of changes in this update:[/p][p][/p][h1]Changelog[/h1][p][/p][h2]New Features:[/h2][list][*][p]11th dungeon added. Complete the 10th dungeon to unlock it;[/p][/*][*][p]New loot and quests added with the new dungeon;[/p][/*][*][p]Rune System added to the game. Unlock runes by completing bosses' Bestiary entries;[/p][/*][*][p]Added a toggleable "Auto Attack" functionality;[/p][/*][*][p]Added new Steam achievements;[/p][/*][*][p]Gems can now be locked on the Gem Storage menu. Locked gems won't appear on the melding list;[/p][/*][/list][h2]Adjustments:[/h2][list][*][p]Replaced the Dodge Chance enemy display in combat with a Bestiary completion bar;[/p][/*][*][p]Crests no longer appear in your HUD during battle, now replaced by your currently equipped Rune;[/p][/*][*][p]Added a toggle button to show/hide combat stats during battle;[/p][/*][*][p]Spells are now sorted by category and alphabetical order;[/p][/*][*][p]Consumables are now sorted by category and alphabetical order;[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the confirmation icon for Gem Crafting;[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the confirmation icon for Gem Melding;[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the "Leech" item sprite;[/p][/*][*][p]Added more information to the "Badge Stats" interface;[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the "Spell Shop" music to be played on the Mages Guild instead[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Forfeit button to the Card Flipper minigame;[/p][/*][*][p]Balancing Adjustments:[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the Power of all damage spells;[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the power of the "Heal" and "Great Heal" spells, but also reduced their cost;[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the cost of the following spells:[/p][/*][*][p]- Magic Shield;[/p][/*][*][p]- Panacea;[/p][/*][*][p]- Renewal;[/p][/*][*][p]- Seal Wound;[/p][/*][*][p]- Strong Magic Shield;[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the power of the following skills:[/p][/*][*][p]- Darkmoon Chant;[/p][/*][*][p]- Flaming Strike;[/p][/*][*][p]- Torch Strike;[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the effectiveness of the "Enchant Weapon" skill;[/p][/*][*][p]Self-buffing spells and skills now only spend half of your action bar;[/p][/*][*][p]Status clearing spells now only spend 3/4 of your action bar;[/p][/*][*][p]The following skills now only spend 3/4 of your action bar:[/p][/*][*][p]- Iai;[/p][/*][*][p]- Shield Bash;[/p][/*][*][p]- Torch Attack;[/p][/*][*][p]- Weak Magic Affinity;[/p][/*][*][p]The following consumables now spend less your action bar:[/p][/*][*][p]- Accursed Skull;[/p][/*][*][p]- Antidote Potion;[/p][/*][*][p]- Black Firebomb;[/p][/*][*][p]- Cool Drink;[/p][/*][*][p]- Energy Drink;[/p][/*][*][p]- Firebomb;[/p][/*][*][p]- Lacerating Knife;[/p][/*][*][p]- Leech;[/p][/*][*][p]- Poisoned Knife;[/p][/*][*][p]- Rusting Powder;[/p][/*][*][p]- Small Stone;[/p][/*][*][p]- Throwing Knife;[/p][/*][*][p]- Voodoo Doll;[/p][/*][*][p]Added a chance of inflicting "Burn" status to the "Firebomb" and "Black Firebomb" items;[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the stats of the following badges:[/p][/*][*][p]- Monster Hunter;[/p][/*][*][p]- Monster Slayer;[/p][/*][*][p]- Monster Bane;[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the stats of the following Equipments:[/p][/*][*][p]- Magus Robe;[/p][/*][*][p]- Magus Hat;[/p][/*][*][p]- Star Lined Robe;[/p][/*][*][p]- Star Lined Hat[/p][/*][*][p]- Visage of Despair;[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bugfixes:[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed the HP yellow bar draining speed;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed consumables showing the inventory quantity when equipped if above 99;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the game registering a kill twice when a boss heals after a kill;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused Dungeon Completion to not register if you had the "Monster Bane" badge unlocked;[/p][/*][*][p]Stackable buffs that share the same type will now keep the number of stacks when reapplied from other sources;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "Vampire Fang +2" reducing Attack and Magic Attack instead of defenses;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed equipments sorting incorrectly after changing some equipment parts;[/p][/*][*][p]Quests that need equipped consumables no longer require you to unequip the items to deliver them;[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: [v1.2.0]
notes.content:
With this update comes some adjustments to Soul Gems and pets.

Now the first effect of a Soul Gem is tied to their type, along with some effect rate adjustments and some new effects added to the pool. [b][i]Do note that these changes will only take effect on new saves (created in v1.2.0 forward), as they would break earlier saves. Older saves will still remain with the previous Soul Gem system.[/i][/b]

Pets also had their slots rebalanced, but if you have gems incompatible with the new slots, don't worry, you won't lose them. The slot will update automatically when you remove the equipped gem.

Now Soul Gems are divided into the following types:

[b]Radial (Fighter): [/b]
[list][*]Includes effects that directly boost your physical attack power and/or favors the fighter playstyle;[/list]
[b]Moon (Mage):[/b]
[list][*]Includes effects that boost your magic attack power, spells, mana and favors the mage playstyle;[/list]
[b]Triangle (Thief):[/b]
[list][*]Includes effects that boost your critical, dodge and lockpicking, favoring the thief playstyle;[/list]
[b]Circle (Defensive)[/b]
[list][*]Includes effects that increases your HP, regeneration and defenses, supporting any playstyle defensively.[/list]

With these changes, there will be a bit more strategy involved with your pet selection, along with more thematic cohesion. With all that said, here's the changelog for this version:

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Adjustments:[/h2]
[list][*] Reworked the Soul Gem system;
[*] Stats shown when equipping Soul Gems to pets are now the same as the stats shown when changing equipments;
[*] Added an option to toggle a confirmation prompt when running from combat;
[*] Added a button to sell all of your selected item to the "Junk Buyer" shop;[/list]

[h2]Balancing Adjustments:[/h2]
[list][*] Changed all pet Soul Gem slots to better fit their niche and theme;[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed equipped Soul Gems on the "Equip Pet" interface not showing their values properly;
[*] Fixed crashes from old saves imported from the Demo;[/list]

[i]Do note that, while I appreciate all the feedback, I'll start working on adding the next dungeon soon, so bugfixes and small quality of life features will be prioritized in place of major game changing updates. Some suggestions might be considered for future dungeons or features, so even if I don't implement everything suggested, it is always appreciated.[/i]

Thank you for your support and understanding!

notes.title: [v1.1.1]
[v1.1.0]
[Demo v0.1.7.2]
notes.content:
[p]Another small update to address some minor issues and with a bonus new feature: Card Flipper!

Have you ever played the Triple Triad minigame in any Final Fantasy game? That's pretty much it. 
It's a simple card game where you need to flip the majority of the cards on the board to match your color. For now, you can unlock it by clearing the first dungeon and completing a quest.

You can earn new cards by completing each monster's bestiary entry, and in the final game you'll be able to use it as an alternate way of earning Soul Shards (which will be used for a system related to character progression). In the demo you can play it for fun, so you won't earn shards, but at least you can get used to the minigame by practicing against Yulia, the Innkeeper.

I hope you all like it, but if that's not the case, you don't need to feel obligated in any way to interact with it, it's just an alternate way to earn specific ingame rewards available through other means!
[/p][h1]Changelog[/h1][p][/p][h2]Adjustments:[/h2][list][*][p]Added a new side minigame: Card Flipper;[/p][/*][/list][h2][/h2][h2]Bugfixes:[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the game would announce that your pet leveled up, even if it didn't, at the Rewards screen;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that made the save file name display incorrectly when deleting a save;
[/p][/*][/list][p]That's it for now, release date is pretty close, so if you find any bugs be sure to report them, either through our Discord community or through the Steam community board!

Thank you for your continued support![/p]
